'''''Kizbon's Box''''' was a [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''-class light interceptor]] operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was the target of an [[Ambush near Darknon Station|ambush]] near [[Darknon Station]] by a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] band led by [[Larken]]. However, the three vessels under his command were destroyed by the [[Crotok]] [[Unidentified pilot (Kizbon's Box)|pilot]].
